title: Canonical - Vesting
description: Canonical (hypothetical OCF) representation of vesting: a reusable schedule template (VestingScheduleTemplate) composed of one or more VestingStatements. Each statement is anchored either to a date (the per-grant anchor supplied by TX_CANONICAL_VESTING_START) or to a named event (whose firing is recorded by TX_CANONICAL_VESTING_EVENT). Assumes CUMULATIVE_ROUND_DOWN allocation throughout.

VestingScheduleTemplate.description: Reusable vesting schedule shape, independent of any specific grant. Per-grant binding is carried on TX_CANONICAL_EQUITY_COMPENSATION_ISSUANCE (refs a template) plus a separate TX_CANONICAL_VESTING_START that anchors the schedule to a wall-clock date.

VestingStatement.description: One segment within a template; produces a sequence of vesting events at the given cadence. The segment's clock begins when its `vesting_base` resolves — either when the per-grant date anchor is set (via TX_CANONICAL_VESTING_START) for a DATE base, or when the named event fires (via TX_CANONICAL_VESTING_EVENT) for an EVENT base.

vesting_base.description: What the statement's vesting clock is anchored to. DATE statements anchor to the per-grant date supplied by TX_CANONICAL_VESTING_START. EVENT statements anchor to a named event whose firing is recorded by TX_CANONICAL_VESTING_EVENT; the firing's date becomes the statement's anchor.

period.description: Length of one installment, in period_type units. Total segment duration is occurrences * period.

VestingBaseDate.description: Anchor that resolves from the per-grant date supplied by TX_CANONICAL_VESTING_START. Carries no payload; the anchor date is held by the start transaction, not the spec.

VestingBaseEvent.description: Anchor that resolves when a named event fires (witnessed by TX_CANONICAL_VESTING_EVENT). The event's definition (what it means, how it is achieved) is not modeled by canonical; consumers maintain that meaning out-of-band. Multiple VestingStatements may reference the same event_id.

event_id.description: Identifier of the event this statement is anchored to. Matches `event_id` on a TX_CANONICAL_VESTING_EVENT.

Cliff.description: Optional cliff on a VestingStatement. `occurrence` is the 1-indexed installment at which the cliff applies (must be <= the containing VestingStatement.occurrences).
